paragraphs: Chattermill’s mission to turn every customer touch into actionable insight mirrors my recent work building NLP and agentic RAG workflows that surface hidden intent from unstructured data.
I built NLP and agentic RAG workflows with Hugging Face Transformers, Ollama, LangChain and LangGraph, enabling rapid retrieval‑augmented generation for real‑time feedback analysis.

I developed an XGBoost churn classifier in R using tidymodels, a two‑stage Bayesian hyperparameter search, SMOTE inside the recipe and MCC evaluation, delivering a robust predictive model for churn risk.
Could we schedule a brief call so I can walk you through how these techniques could power Chattermill’s next‑action recommendations?
